Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較: 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。 CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束: 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。 Orszag–Tang：条件を揃えたCT・GLMと独立参照の収束: 同じOT初期セル平均と同じdt列でCT/GLMを計算し、別に実行したAthena++の格子・時間感度を分離した参照と比較します。 CTの初期制約保持とGLMの能動的cleaning：非物理診断対照: 故意にdiv B≠0とした同じcell磁場で、CTが初期違反を除去しないこととGLMのB/ψ応答を確認します。物理問題数へ加算しない診断対照です。 追加の実際の2D磁場ループと衝撃波形成後Orszag–Tangで、edge EMFとface磁場のCT更新を使用。独立Athenaの有限格子参照と発散・エネルギーを別々に確認します。 Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較 · These files do not verify every variant of the named method. numart/mhd.py numart/hlld.py numart/mhd_tests.py tests/test_hlld.py Download the complete edition and run it python -m pytest -q tests/test_hlld.py Small dedicated implementations and measured checks Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++: Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++. CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium: Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence. Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references: Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated. Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control: Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem. Additional actual2D magnetic-loop and postshock Orszag–Tang use edge EMFs and face-field CT updates. Separately check divergence/energy against finite-grid independent Athena references.
